account: Today appears quiet so far. I attended the morning market walk, bought two fresh loaves, and returned home for the noon appointment. I am now back at the office for the one o'clock town accounts. Several townsfolk had no news. Townsfolk 28, 18, and 08 reported that the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery; that seems consistent with bread production, and I have no evidence of anything unusual about it. The main unresolved matter is my three o'clock tea invitation: the appointment book names only a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank. The secretary took custody of the appointment book and said they would visit the dockside cottages to identify the host and report before tea, either at my home at noon or at the office after one. I have not yet received that report. I do not know the host's identity or the purpose of the tea beyond the scheduled social visit.
